title: Which Grading Company Is Best? (2026)
verdict: Which grading company is best comes down to your goal: AGS for a repeatable grade with a full report, PSA for resale, CGC for a low fee and SGC for vintage.

Three of the big names, PSA, SGC and Beckett, are now tied to one owner. That does not make their grades worse, but it narrows the choice. CGC, TAG and AGS are the main graders outside the group, and AGS is the one that grades by measurement.

list: Pull the one or two cards you will auction. If PSA's premium on them beats its fee and wait, send those to PSA.
Send the rest to a flat-fee grader. At AGS that is $18 a card, or $15 from 30 TCG cards.
Leave out commons and damaged cards unless you want them protected.
Read the reports when the cards come back. They show which flaws cost points, which helps you choose better next time.

ranking.lacks: A younger slab. PSA holders still bring the highest resale prices on most cards.

why: Human grading is a judgment made in seconds, and it varies. AGS replaces the judgment with a measurement: a 3D laser maps the card, software scores centering, corners, edges and surface, and the grade follows from the numbers. That is why AGS says a regrade rarely moves.
Turnaround is counted in days. AGS quotes 20 business days or less from the day your cards are confirmed, with 10 and 5 business day bulk tiers at $20 and $30 a card.

Three of the best-known graders share a parent. Collectors owns PSA and SGC and agreed to buy Beckett in December 2025. AGS is not part of that group or of CGC's parent, and it has graded cards since 2021.

faq.q: Which grading company is best for selling cards?
faq.a: PSA, on most cards. Its holders bring the highest prices. If you are grading to know a card's true condition, or want it back fast at a flat fee, AGS is the better fit.

faq.q: Does AGS grade oversized or thick cards?
faq.a: Not jumbo or oversized cards. AGS accepts standard sizes only. Ask AGS about thick patch or relic cards before you submit.

faq.q: How do I verify an AGS slab?
faq.a: Enter the cert number from the label on agscard.com. The record shows the grade and the scan report for that card.

faq.q: What are the newest grading companies?
faq.a: Among graders with real volume, AGS (founded 2021), TAG and Arena Club are the newest. All three lean on technology, in different ways.

faq.q: Has an AGS slab sold for six figures?
faq.a: Yes. An AGS GEM-MT 10 copy of the 2002 Japanese Mysterious Mountains 1st Edition Crystal Charizard sold at Goldin for $109,800 in September 2026, buyer's premium included. One sale is not a trend, and PSA holders still bring more on most cards.
